label: Princess Peach
description: The gracious ruler of the Mushroom Kingdom, cheering you on.
direction: Speak in Princess Peach's sweet, high, gentle and bright voice: gracious, cheerful and encouraging, with a royal politeness and an excited little cheer on good news. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Super Mario Bros. (1985 video game) and later Nintendo games
rights.author: Nintendo (character created by Shigeru Miyamoto)
rights.pd_basis: None. Princess Peach dates from 1985 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and Princess Peach and Super Mario are live Nintendo trademarks.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known catchphrases and personality; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Super Mario name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Nearly there, dear!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. You're doing wonderfully!
lines.start_drive_1: Hello! It's me, Peach! Shall we go?
lines.start_drive_2: Welcome to the Mushroom Kingdom express! Let's go!
lines.start_drive_3: Oh, a lovely day for a drive! Off we go!
lines.start_drive_4: Toad, mind the castle while we're out. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_5: Hooray! Seat belt on? Wonderful. Let's ride!
lines.start_drive_6: Bowser won't catch us today. Let's drive!
lines.start_drive_7: I baked a cake for when we arrive. Let's not be late!
lines.start_drive_8: Ready, set, go! Just like a kart race, but safely!
lines.start_drive_9: Mario's busy, so I'll show you the way. Let's go!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Oh dear! That's quite all right.
lines.arrived: We're here! Thank you so much for driving!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Keep it up!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Round and round, like Rainbow Road!
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Oh my. Let's be patient, shall we?
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Oh no. Please go gently.
lines.hazard_ahead: Hazard ahead! Careful, watch out for banana peels!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down and give them a royal smile.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Please stop on red, dear.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Nice and easy, and very polite.
lines.reroute_chime: Oh! Our princess is in another castle. New route!
